author: The Current
description:
Gary Louris talks about working with producer Bob Ezrin on the Jayhawks' new album, "Sanctuary Park"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

The Jayhawks’ Gary Louris talks about working with producer Bob Ezrin on the band’s latest album, “Sanctuary Park.” Ezrin is a highly versatile producer who has worked with a vast array of artists, including Pink Floyd, Deep Purple, Rod Stewart, Kiss, Air Supply, and Andrea Bocelli — and he also produced the Jayhawks’ 2000 album, “Smile.”

“We both agreed this would not be ‘Smile 2.0’,” Louris says. Watch more in the video above, and find a studio session of the Jayhawks playing songs from “Sanctuary Park” here: https://youtu.be/fUAOqqE2v-A

description:
Watch The Jayhawks perform "Keeping Our Heads Above Water" in studio
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Gary Louris is on a mission to prove that a person in their 70s can still produce some of their best work. That’s indeed rare. But so is keeping a band together for 40 years, being credited as pioneer of Americana music, touring with Johnny Cash … the list goes on for Louris and his iconic Minnesota band, The Jayhawks. 

The Local Show’s September Artist of the Month performed three songs in-studio from their 12th album Sanctuary Park. Producer Bob Ezrin (Pink Floyd, Alice Cooper, Peter Gabriel) volunteered to record the LP after Louris called to catch up with the Canadian legend after he renounced his American citizenship, citing his disgruntlement with the country’s extreme political division.
